rationale: Revised plan corrects critical target leakage and adds missing caveat. Removed billed_amount, allowed_amount, member_oop, and cob_amount from feature_set because these fields are known only after claim adjudication and introduce leakage in the model predictions. Model now uses only submission-time features: claim and service attributes (claim_type, place_of_service, provider_specialty), clinical indicators (primary_icd10_cm, drg_present), service details (cpt_category, service_units, length_of_stay), and claim flags (er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, network_status). Added synthetic_data caveat to report as required. All other components remain unchanged: 25% test holdout, percentile-90 threshold on paid_amount computed on training data, logistic regression and random forest models, and model limitation and class imbalance caveats.
changes_summary: Removed 4 amount fields (billed_amount, allowed_amount, member_oop, cob_amount) from feature_set to eliminate target leakage; model now uses only submission-time features available when claims arrive. Added 'synthetic_data' caveat to write_report. These changes address the high-severity leakage finding and missing caveat, which will resolve the out-of-range ROC-AUC metrics.
